svg.text: CLEAR TAKEAWAY CONTAINER, 750 mL: REV D (CORRECTED), PLUG-SEAL + SNAP-FIT LID
Supersedes Rev C (CTC-750-003). All dimensions mm. Views 1:1 unless noted. Concept for thermoformed PET/rPET, chilled/ambient use; not a manufacturing release.
Hidden: wall top 186x126 R10, foot 164x104 R4, ribs, nest lugs (4x, 10 long, inner face y = +/-58.5, z 39-41). Opening 184.7x124.7 R9.35 at z = 51.35.
Six catch pads (orange): 2 per long side at x = +/-45, 30 long; 1 per short side, centred, 30 long. Four corner zones have no pad (peel start).
Closed envelope 191.6 x 131.6 x 54.0 (52.5 excluding stacking ring). Base 190 x 130 x 52.
750 mL fill line: 39.31 above inside floor (z = 39.96)
DETAIL B SNAP + PLUG SEAL (8:1) at section A-A, short end
lead-in chamfer 0.40 x 0.40; pad height 0.80; tip face 0.40
plug: 0.50 wall, 0.10 interference with cavity wall
Detail drawn at 8x with all thicknesses to spec. Pad and plug edges shown sharp for clarity; supplier to confirm formed undercut and tool release.
FUSION USER PARAMETERS (Rev D) * = adjustable for fit / seal tests
1 Section and side views redrawn true to spec: flange/floor 0.65 (were ~2.5/2.0), taper 12.1 deg (was ~7), foot 164, height 52 / 52.5.
2 Side elevation now shows the tapered body (was straight-sided, 58 mm tall). Plan inner-opening radius R9.35 (was R11.35); lid R12.8 (was R13).
3 Section cut line A-A added to plan; scale stated (1:1, Detail B 8:1); sheet is standard A2. Pad length and position now dimensioned.
4 Snap capture 0.50 (was 0.20, below forming variation), 45 deg lead-in, parametric. Interference check: pads clear the base (0 mm3).
5 Leak concept added: tapered plug wall 3.0 deep, 0.5 thick, 0.10 interference (CAD interference 187 mm3 = seal preload). Untested.
6 Lid stiffening ribs (1.0) and stacking ring (1.5) added; 4 nesting lugs on base long walls. Ribs/ring are solid stand-ins for formed features.
7 Capacity re-derived from CAD cavity: 750 mL at 39.31 mm above inside floor (Rev C: 39.47). Inside floor 162.98 x 102.98 (constant wall).
8 Weight flag: nominal 0.65 / 0.5 gauge gives ~42 g base + ~24 g lid (PET 1.38 g/cc) before thinning. Review gauge with supplier.
SHORT-SKIRT SNAP-FIT TAKEAWAY CONTAINER WITH PLUG SEAL
Base 190 x 130 x 52, lid 191.6 x 131.6 x 54.0; 750 mL at 39.31 mm fill. Matches Fusion model parameters.
